title: POS sale transaction with fractional quantities
description: Verify that the POS interface correctly processes sales with fractional quantities and logs the transaction immutably.

steps.description: Navigate to the mobile-optimized POS interface
Input a sale with fractional quantity of a product (e.g., 1.5 units)
Complete the sale with a cashier role
Verify the sale completes successfully within 2 minutes
Verify sale transaction is immutable and logged in the audit trail with correct quantity and user context

title: Price override in POS with role validation
description: Verify that price overrides in the POS require appropriate user role and the override is logged in audit logs.

steps.description: Login as a user without override permissions
Attempt to apply a price override in POS
Verify override is rejected due to insufficient permissions
Login as a Supervisor or Manager with override permissions
Apply a price override in POS
Verify override is accepted and properly logged with user ID and timestamp in audit logs

title: Inventory intake recording and audit logging
description: Validate that inventory intake operations are recorded with derived cost per unit, and all changes are audit logged immutably.

steps.description: Navigate to inventory intake interface
Record intake of new inventory items with quantity and cost
Verify calculated derived cost per unit is correct
Verify inventory intake change is logged in audit trail with user context and timestamps

title: Inventory adjustment audit logging
description: Test that inventory adjustments are logged with immutable historical data and user context.

steps.description: Login with Manager role
Adjust inventory quantity for a product
Verify original inventory data remains unchanged and adjustment creates new immutable record
Verify adjustment is logged with user ID, timestamp, and adjustment reason in audit logs

title: Tax configuration and rounding correctness
description: Verify the system applies configurable taxes per business and uses deterministic rounding rules for price calculations.

steps.description: Configure business-specific tax rates (inclusive and exclusive)
Perform sale transaction in POS with tax applied
Verify tax amount calculation matches expected deterministic rule
Verify rounding of final price follows configured rounding rules

title: Customer profile creation, notes, and soft-disabling
description: Validate CRM customer profiles enable addition of purchase history, notes, status flags, and support soft-disabling instead of deletion.

steps.description: Create a new customer profile with required details
Add purchase history and notes to the customer profile
Apply status flags to the profile
Soft-disable the customer profile
Verify profile data remains in the system and is marked as disabled but not deleted

title: Audit logs access with tenant isolation and filtering
description: Verify Audit Logs API returns only the logs for the requested tenant and supports filtering by action, type, and date range.

steps.description: Request audit logs via API specifying business_id (tenant)
Verify returned logs belong only to the specified tenant
Apply filters for action, type, and date range in API request
Verify returned logs are correctly filtered according to specified parameters
Verify audit logs are append-only and cannot be altered or deleted

title: Team member creation with role hierarchy enforcement
description: Verify that team creation API enforces role hierarchy preventing improper role assignments such as assigning Owner by Manager.

steps.description: Attempt to create a team member with a higher role than allowed by creator (Manager assigns Owner)
Verify the creation request is rejected with proper error message
Create a team member with allowed role assignment
Verify member is created successfully

title: Team member role update with hierarchy enforcement
description: Verify that role update API prevents unauthorized elevation or improper role changes according to strict role hierarchy.

steps.description: Attempt to update a team member role to a higher role than permitted by the updater
Verify the update is rejected and audit logs record the attempt
Perform a valid role update within allowed hierarchy
Verify role update succeeds and audit logs record the change

title: RTBF deletion masks PII and removes tenant roles
description: Validate RTBF Deletion API permanently masks PII fields and removes tenant roles for the specified user, ensuring privacy compliance.

steps.description: Submit RTBF deletion request via API for a tenant user
Verify all PII fields are permanently masked and no longer retrievable
Verify the user's roles associated with the tenant are removed
Verify audit logs capture the RTBF deletion action

title: Role-based access control enforcement at database level
description: Verify that role-based access control is strictly enforced at the database level to prevent unauthorized actions or permission changes.

steps.description: Attempt to perform restricted actions (e.g., price override) using a user role without permission, bypassing UI
Verify database denies unauthorized action
Attempt to change roles or permissions directly at database
Verify database rejects unauthorized role/permission modifications and logs the attempt

title: Audit logs capture all sensitive financial changes
description: Ensure that every sensitive financial change such as price overrides, voids, refunds, and inventory adjustments is recorded in append-only audit logs with full context.

steps.description: Perform price override in POS by authorized user
Verify audit log records price override with user, timestamp, old and new price
Void a transaction
Verify audit log captures the void action
Process a refund
Verify refund is logged in audit trail
Adjust inventory quantity
Verify audit log contains full adjustment details and user context

title: Mobile POS usability and performance under 2 minutes for new staff
description: Verify that new staff can complete a sales transaction end-to-end on mobile POS within 2 minutes, testing operational speed and usability.

steps.description: Login as a new cashier user
Using only one hand, complete a sale with fractional quantity and price override (if allowed)
Measure and verify total time taken is under 2 minutes

title: Reject unauthorized team membership modifications
description: Verify system rejects unauthorized team membership actions such as adding members without proper permissions or invalid roles.

steps.description: Attempt to add a team member with invalid role or without permissions via API
Verify request is denied and audit logs record the failed attempt

title: No unlogged financial changes occur
description: Ensure that no financial changes or sensitive business modifications can occur without generating verifiable audit log entries.

steps.description: Try to modify prices, inventory, or transactions using unconventional or direct requests bypassing UI
Verify system rejects changes if not properly logged
Verify audit logs contain entries for all successful financial changes with complete details
